idle_dim.label: Dim the screen after
idle_dim.help: Minutes without a key press before the screen dims.

idle_lock.label: Lock after
idle_lock.help: Minutes without a key press before it locks (not while Caps Lock is ON).

idle_sleep.label: Sleep after
idle_sleep.help: Minutes without a key press before the laptop sleeps.

power_mode.label: Processor
power_mode.help: saver: cooler and longer battery. full: fastest, warmer.

charge_limit.label: Stop charging at
charge_limit.help: Keeps the battery healthy. If the laptop doesn't allow it from Golem, set it in the BIOS (F2 > Power Management > Primary Battery Charge Configuration > Custom).

camera.label: Camera
camera.help: OFF: the camera's driver isn't loaded at all, so nothing can use it.

microphone.label: Microphone
microphone.help: OFF: the sound card's recording side is switched off for everything.

bluetooth_driver.label: Bluetooth
bluetooth_driver.help: OFF: the Bluetooth driver isn't loaded at all.

wifi_driver.label: Wi-Fi card
wifi_driver.help: OFF: the Wi-Fi driver isn't loaded at all (stronger than Super+N).

usb_storage.label: USB drives
usb_storage.help: OFF: USB sticks and disks aren't read at all. Not possible while Golem itself runs from a USB drive.

card_reader.label: Card reader
card_reader.help: OFF: the SD card reader's driver isn't loaded.

trackers.label: Block trackers and ads
trackers.help: A built-in list (StevenBlack, about 76,000 sites) blocks them for every app. It changes only when you update Golem.

kbd_delay.label: Key repeat starts after
kbd_delay.help: How long you hold a key before it repeats.

kbd_rate.label: Key repeat speed
kbd_rate.help: How fast a held key repeats.

face.label: Face
face.help: SHADOW: pale light on black. NEGATIVE: ink on white. (Super+I switches it anywhere.)

effects.label: Effects
effects.help: Drifting motes and the gather and melt between pages. OFF is calmer and lighter.

motes.label: Motes
motes.help: How many motes drift behind the panel.

alert_key.label: Dismiss the red alert with
alert_key.help: The key you press to dismiss a red alert.

alert_presses.label: Presses to dismiss
alert_presses.help: So an alert is never dismissed by accident.

alert_battery.label: Alert when the battery is at
alert_battery.help: A red alert when the battery runs this low and isn't charging.

alert_disk.label: Alert when the pendrive is full to
alert_disk.help: A red alert when Golem's drive is this full.
